Danish

Alternative forms

  • tusinde

Etymology

From Old Danish thusændæ, thusænd, thusind, thusand, from Old Norse þúsund, from Proto-Germanic *þūsundī.

Pronunciation

  • IPA(key): /tuːsən(ə)/, [ˈtˢuˀsn̩], [ˈtˢuˀsn̩nə]

Numeral

tusind

  1. thousand

Noun

tusind n (singular definite tusindet, plural indefinite tusinder or tusind)

  1. a thousand (a unit of ca. 1000 pieces)
